'''''Dianthus broteri''''' is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the [[carnation]] family [[Caryophyllaceae]]. It is native to [[Portugal]] and [[Spain]], preferring to grow close to the coasts.<ref name="153161-1" >{{cite web |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:153161-1 |title=''Dianthus broteri'' Boiss. & Reut. |author=<!--Not stated--> |date=2017 |website=Plants of the World Online |publisher=Board of Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew |access-date=16 August 2020 }}</ref> ''Dianthus broteri'' is a complex of [[polyploidy|polyploid]] races, with 2n=2x=30, 2n=4x=60, 2n=6x=90 and 2n=12x=180 chromosomes detected in different populations, the largest polyploid series in the genus.<ref>{{cite journal |doi=10.1093/aob/mcp182 |title=Distribution and diversity of cytotypes in ''Dianthus broteri'' as evidenced by genome size variations |year=2009 |last1=Balao |first1=Francisco |last2=Casimiro-Soriguer |first2=Ramón |last3=Talavera |first3=María |last4=Herrera |first4=Javier |last5=Talavera |first5=Salvador |journal=Annals of Botany |volume=104 |issue=5 |pages=965–973 |pmid=19633312 |pmc=2749526 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |doi=10.1111/j.1469-8137.2010.03280.x |title=Radiative evolution of polyploid races of the Iberian carnation ''Dianthus broteri'' (Caryophyllaceae) |year=2010 |last1=Balao |first1=Francisco |last2=Valente |first2=Luis M. |last3=Vargas |first3=Pablo |last4=Herrera |first4=Javier |last5=Talavera |first5=Salvador |journal=New Phytologist |volume=187 |issue=2 |pages=542–551 |pmid=20456054 |doi-access=free }}</ref>
